# n5 - Dispatch: validation, policy, leases, and the dispatch plan

`RunnerPolicy` is the kind table: which model a kind runs on, whether it gets a worktree, its
retry cap, and its diff rule. `RunnerDispatch.dispatch(context, limit:)` validates the graph,
computes the ready set, applies policy, mints leases, builds packets, writes `running`, and prints
the dispatch plan the session spawns from.

The full validator runs before the first dispatch of an intent; a cycle check runs before every
dispatch (C9, C12). A ready decision node is never dispatched: it stops the loop with
`needs_decision` and the exact `runner answer` command that clears it. A node at its kind's retry
cap becomes `needs_decision` rather than being dispatched again.

The dispatch plan is text and knows nothing about either harness: per node, the packet path, the
model, the worktree path, the kind, and the agent role, plus the return contract the executor must
emit.

Two caps are in play and both are real (D22). The runner's soft cap parks a node at
`needs_decision` after two `failed_verification` lines for work, one for research and verify.
`ReadySet::DEFAULT_CAPS` stays the transition layer's hard backstop, counted as `running` lines
since the last terminal line, and `node-transition` is not changed to accept an override. When a
node reaches the hard backstop the runner says so by name, because the exit is `runner answer`, not
another dispatch.

The packet's "where to work" block would otherwise name the intent worktree. The runner injects a
node-scoped `worktree_reader:` into `NodePacket.build`, which already accepts one (D23).

## n5 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5.1 | Run the full validator before the first dispatch | An invalid graph dispatches its first node and the run is built on a graph nobody checked | `runner_dispatch_test#test_full_validator_runs_before_first_dispatch` |
| 5.2 | Refuse to dispatch when the validator fails | Validation reports and dispatch happens anyway | `runner_dispatch_test#test_invalid_graph_refuses_dispatch` |
| 5.3 | Skip the full validator once a node has been dispatched | Every step pays the full validation cost and a mid-run graph edit blocks the loop | `runner_dispatch_test#test_validator_skipped_after_first_dispatch` |
| 5.4 | Re-read `graph.md` and cycle-check before every dispatch | A cycle introduced mid-run is dispatched into and two nodes wait on each other forever | `runner_dispatch_test#test_cycle_check_runs_every_dispatch` |
| 5.5 | Dispatch at most `2 - running` nodes | Concurrency two is a suggestion and a step with two live nodes dispatches two more | `runner_dispatch_test#test_dispatch_respects_concurrency_ceiling` |
| 5.6 | Dispatch nothing when two nodes are already running | The ceiling is checked against the ready set rather than the ledger and always dispatches | `runner_dispatch_test#test_no_dispatch_when_two_running` |
| 5.7 | Dispatch in `ready-set` order | The runner picks its own order and the critical path is not what runs first | `runner_dispatch_test#test_dispatch_follows_ready_set_order` |
| 5.8 | Refuse to dispatch a node whose `files:` overlap a running sibling | Two agents write the same file and one silently loses | `runner_dispatch_test#test_file_overlap_blocks_dispatch` |
| 5.9 | Stop the loop on a ready decision node | A decision node is dispatched to an agent, which answers a question meant for the owner | `runner_dispatch_test#test_ready_decision_node_stops_loop` |
| 5.10 | Print the `runner answer` command for that decision node | The loop stops and the owner is not told how to clear it | `runner_dispatch_test#test_decision_stop_prints_answer_command` |
| 5.11 | Turn a node at its retry cap into `needs_decision` | A node that has failed twice is dispatched a third time and burns another attempt | `runner_dispatch_test#test_node_at_retry_cap_becomes_needs_decision` |
| 5.12 | Count the retry cap from `failed_verification` lines | The cap counts attempts instead, so a reclaimed crash counts as a failure | `runner_policy_test#test_retry_cap_counts_failed_verification_only` |
| 5.13 | Resolve the executor model for work and research nodes | Every node runs on a default model and the config override does nothing | `runner_policy_test#test_work_and_research_use_executor_model` |
| 5.14 | Resolve the advisor model for verify nodes | Verification runs on the cheap model, which is the one thing D31 rules out | `runner_policy_test#test_verify_uses_advisor_model` |
| 5.15 | Fall back to a shipped default when config names no model | A blank config resolves to an empty model and the `running` line is refused for a missing field | `runner_policy_test#test_model_falls_back_to_shipped_default` |
| 5.16 | Give work nodes a worktree and the other kinds none | A verify node gets a worktree and the diff rule has something to catch | `runner_policy_test#test_worktree_only_for_work_kind` |
| 5.17 | Give an unknown kind the widest cap rather than no policy | A node whose kind is unreadable falls through to no cap and dispatches forever | `runner_policy_test#test_unknown_kind_uses_work_policy` |
| 5.18 | Build the packet before writing `running` | `running` lands with a `packet=` naming bytes that do not exist | `runner_dispatch_test#test_packet_built_before_running_line` |
| 5.19 | Write `running` with `holder=`, `expires=`, `packet=` and `model=` | The line is refused for a missing required field and the node never starts | `runner_dispatch_test#test_running_line_carries_required_fields` |
| 5.20 | Roll back the worktree and packet when `running` is refused | A refused transition leaves a provisioned worktree and a packet file behind for a node that never ran | `runner_dispatch_test#test_refused_running_rolls_back_side_effects` |
| 5.21 | Set `expires=` from the kind's lease length | Every node gets the same lease and a long build is reclaimed under a working executor | `runner_policy_test#test_lease_length_comes_from_kind` |
| 5.22 | Print the packet path, model, worktree, kind and role per dispatched node | The session has nothing to spawn from and the plan is prose | `runner_dispatch_test#test_plan_lists_packet_model_worktree_kind_role` |
| 5.23 | Print the return contract in the plan, not in the packet | The packet bytes change and `packet=<sha>` stops naming a reproducible input | `runner_dispatch_test#test_return_contract_is_in_plan_not_packet` |
| 5.24 | Print a machine-readable plan | The session parses prose and mis-spawns on a reworded line | `runner_dispatch_test#test_plan_is_machine_readable` |
| 5.25 | Report complete only when every declared node is terminal (D21, meld of blocker 2) | `ranked_ready` is empty for a blocked run as well as a finished one, so a stalled intent reports complete with nodes outstanding | `runner_dispatch_test#test_complete_requires_all_nodes_terminal` |
| 5.25a | Report stalled, with blockers, when the ready set is empty and work remains | The loop stops and nobody is told which node blocks which | `runner_dispatch_test#test_empty_ready_set_with_work_left_reports_stalled` |
| 5.26 | Name the hard attempt backstop when a node hits it (D22, meld of blocker 4) | A node reclaimed three times after crashes carries no `failed_verification` line, passes the soft cap, and is refused by `node-transition` at exit 5 forever, which then presents as a false complete | `runner_dispatch_test#test_hard_attempt_cap_is_reported_by_name` |
| 5.27 | Synthesize the `question=` when parking a node at the retry cap (D29, meld of major 12) | `needs_decision` requires `question`, so the append raises and the node is left `running` | `runner_dispatch_test#test_retry_cap_needs_decision_carries_question` |
| 5.28 | Print the `runner answer` command that unparks a capped work node (D22) | The loop parks a node the owner has no documented way to release | `runner_dispatch_test#test_capped_node_stop_prints_unpark_command` |
| 5.29 | Point the packet at the node worktree and node branch (D23, meld of blocker 5) | The packet names the intent worktree, the executor commits on the intent branch, the node branch stays empty, the merge is a no-op, and `done` lands on work that was never scope-checked | `runner_dispatch_test#test_packet_names_node_worktree_and_branch` |
| 5.30 | Rebuild a packet with `force` when its attempt has no `running` line (D30, meld of major 11) | `NodePacket.build` exits 5 on a differing attempt file, so a crash between the packet and the `running` line blocks that node forever | `runner_dispatch_test#test_orphan_packet_is_rebuilt_with_force` |
| 5.31 | Stop the step with a named reason when `delivery.lock` is not held (D30, meld of major 16) | `node-transition` exits 4 and the step either raises or half-dispatches | `runner_dispatch_test#test_lock_refusal_is_a_named_step_outcome` |
| 5.32 | Print the re-arm command on a lock refusal | A resumed session with a new id is stuck with no way forward | `runner_dispatch_test#test_lock_refusal_prints_rearm_command` |
| 5.33 | Read the file-overlap refusal from `ReadySet` rather than reimplementing it (meld of minor 29) | Two overlap rules drift apart and one lets a pair through the other would block | `runner_dispatch_test#test_overlap_refusal_comes_from_ready_set` |
| 5.34 | Re-render `graph.md` `## Status` after writing `running` (D28) | The Status table reads `planned` while the node is executing | `runner_dispatch_test#test_dispatch_rerenders_graph_status` |
| 5.35 | Register `runner_dispatch.rb` and `runner_policy.rb` in `core_files` (D25) | `install_sync_test` goes red as soon as `scripts/runner` requires them | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |
